DIGITAL PRODUCT FACTORY — START HERE
=====================================

1. RUN IT
   Double-click dpf.exe.

   There is no installer. The app is a single program.

   YOUR WORK IS SAFE. Your ideas, products, sales, clients and generated
   files are stored OUTSIDE this folder, in your own Windows user data:

       %APPDATA%\DigitalProductFactory\

   That is deliberate, and it is why updating is safe: your data is not
   kept next to the program, so replacing the program cannot touch it.

2. ADD YOUR AI KEY (needed before it can generate anything)
   Open Settings and paste ONE key from any of these:

       OpenAI      Anthropic      Google      DeepSeek      Moonshot

   You bring your own key. The app does not include one and does not
   supply one - you pay your chosen provider directly, at their prices.

3. IF YOU HAVE A LICENCE KEY
   Click the key button at the bottom of the left sidebar and paste it in.


HOW TO UPDATE TO A NEW VERSION
------------------------------

There is no automatic update, and you do not need to delete anything.

   1. Download the new zip from the address you used before.
   2. Unzip it and replace dpf.exe with the new one.

That is the whole update. Your data is not in this folder, so it is
untouched. You do NOT need to re-enter your licence key or your AI key.

DO NOT delete the folder to update - there is no need, and if you have
ever run an older version that kept its data here, deleting would take
that older data with it. The app imports such a file automatically the
first time it starts, and it never deletes the original.


IF THE WINDOW IS BLACK
----------------------

A small number of graphics drivers draw this app as a blank window on one
of the two drawing methods it can use. It is a driver quirk, not a fault in
your copy.

The app normally sorts this out on its own: if the first drawing method
fails to start, it relaunches itself once using the other one. A window
that is black for a few seconds and then appears is that recovery working.

If it stays black, start it with the other method yourself - one
double-click:

    dpf-glow.bat    run with OpenGL   (try this first on a VPS or Windows Server)
    dpf-wgpu.bat    run with DirectX  (the default)

Either way, dpf.exe writes a file called dpf-startup.log into this same
folder. It records which method was tried, which start-up step it reached,
and whether the first frame ever painted. If you need support, send that
file - it is the single most useful thing you can provide.


FILES IN THIS FOLDER
--------------------

    dpf.exe                 the application
    dpf-glow.bat            start it with OpenGL     (use if dpf.exe is black)
    dpf-wgpu.bat            start it with DirectX    (the default)
    feature_tiers.json      which features each plan unlocks, and the upgrade link
    favicon/                the DPF brand icon set, for your own site or listing
    GUIDE.md                the full user guide — how to set up and use every screen
    MODULE-TEST-SHEET.md    a short sheet for checking every screen in the app
    START-HERE.txt          this file
    dpf-startup.log         created after you run it - send this if you need help
